svg.text: Autonomous USB bootstrap; GPIO high-current mode requires a validated >=1.5 A PD contract. Motor ENN stays high at 5 V.
2.2 uF dVdT to isolated RTN: nominal slew 0.0526 V/ms. 24k gives 0.50 A; parallel branch gives 1.00 A. Firmware must limit USB bootstrap draw.
MODE to RTN: current limit with automatic retry; SHDN internal pull-up enables startup. Hold ENN high on fault. RTN must remain separate from GND. Reverse blocking is not a brake.
